title: in the mirror
style: Cinematic dark introspective psychological hip-hop duet featuring alternative trap, emo rap, cloud rap, neo-soul trap, moody R&B and atmospheric electronic elements. Dark cinematic orchestral trap production with heavy 808 bass drops, melancholic piano melodies, glassy synth arpeggios, shimmering reverb tails, tense orchestral string swells, haunting atmospheric pads, crisp trap snares, glass shatter FX and mirror echo production. Raw intimate verses building dramatically to massive layered choruses. Intense storytelling rap, deep psychological lyricism, dark cinematic R&B vibes, psychedelic trap atmosphere, vulnerable introspection, conscious mental health storytelling, raw emotional mental battle delivery, melodic emo rap emotion, moody minimalism, epic orchestral builds, motivational dark trap energy. Male raw gritty passionate rap and singing for Zyn. Ethereal pitched-down haunting processed voice for Reflection with strong call-and-response duet chemistry. Subtle autotune on lead
lyrics:
[Intro - Zyn (soft, raw, whispered over glassy piano)]
Yeah…
The mirror’s staring back again…
[Chorus - Both (call & response, layered, building)]
[Zyn] I’m talking to the mirror
[Mirror] Mirror talking to me, wonder why
[Zyn] I’m talking to the mirror
[Mirror] Deep inside, now I know why
[Verse 1 - Zyn (intense rap, gritty delivery)]
Mirror on the wall, what you tryna show me tonight?
Reflection in my eyes, spinning under the light
I’m the bad guy in the story I wrote sometimes
No authority over the ghost living in these eyes of mine
[Verse 2 - Mirror (echoey, calm but commanding, heavy reverb)]
Pick the right words, calm the storm in the glass
Don’t let the noise push you, you fight to outlast
They don’t understand the war behind the frame
But you keep going — this is your own kind of game
[Verse 3 - Zyn (faster flow, building frustration)]
Just do it, this my psychology
No sympathy for the noise staring back at me
Don’t mess with me when I’m locked in this space
Internal battle, trying to find my place
[Verse 4 - Mirror (smoother, guiding, almost hypnotic)]
Change the plan inside your brain, rewrite the face
Let go of the anger, release the pain from the pane
Put attention on yourself, better hope you heal
This the only way you know how to feel real
[Bridge - Both (call & response, tension rising, orchestral swell)]
[Zyn] No white lies to the man in the glass, let me breathe
[Mirror] Full attention on these thoughts, better hope you believe
[Zyn] I know how to kick the doubt right out the frame
[Mirror] This fire inside — the mirror feels the same
[Chorus - Both (bigger, anthemic, full production drop)]
[Zyn] I’m talking to the mirror
[Mirror] Mirror talking to me, now I see why
[Zyn] I’m talking to the mirror
[Mirror] It’s how I survive… yeah I know why
[Verse 5 - Zyn (raw, questioning, emotional peak)]
Staring deep into the glass, questioning every choice
Every thought a weapon, every doubt got a voice
No authority but the one that burns in my chest
[Verse 6 - Mirror (strong, empowering, final truth)]
Pick the moment, turn the chaos into rest
Society’s pressure trying to crack your flow
But you’re rewriting rules only the mirror knows
Don’t let the noise win, you the mountain, stay strong
Keep talking to me till you know where you belong
[Outro - Both (fading, harmonious, glassy reverb tails)]
[Zyn] Talking to the mirror…
[Mirror] I know why…
[Both] Yeah…
I’m talking to the mirror…
